definitions.explanation: Dealing with each item or person separately rather than as a group. Emphasizes treating things one by one according to their specific circumstances.

examples.japanese: {個別|こべつ}に{対応|たいおう}します。
examples.english: We will handle each case individually.

examples.japanese: {個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}を{受|う}けたい{生徒|せいと}は{申|もう}し{込|こ}んでください。
examples.english: Students who want individual instruction, please sign up.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}は{個別|こべつ}の{事情|じじょう}を{考慮|こうりょ}して{判断|はんだん}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: This issue needs to be judged taking individual circumstances into consideration.

notes:
Used both as a noun ({個別|こべつ}に — individually) and as a modifier ({個別|こべつ}の — individual). Common in business, education, and administrative contexts where uniform treatment is insufficient.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個別|こべつ}{対応|たいおう} (individual handling)
- {個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう} (individual instruction/tutoring)
- {個別|こべつ}{相談|そうだん} (individual consultation)
- {個別|こべつ}に{対応|たいおう}する (deal with individually)
- {個別|こべつ}の{事情|じじょう} (individual circumstances)
